AI NEEDS A NEW INFRASTRUCTURE LAYER. WE'RE BUILDING IT AT MODAL.

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.


Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp https://modal.com/blog/how-ramp-built-a-full-context-background-coding-agent-on-modal, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.


We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation.


Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn,Luigi https://github.com/spotify/luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience.




THE ROLE:

We’re looking for Forward Deployed ML Engineers who want to work at the intersection of deep technical work and direct customer impact. As an ML FDE, you’ll partner with leading AI companies and foundation model labs to help them achieve state-of-the-art performance on their most demanding workloads: LLM serving, model training (SFT, RLHF), audio pipelines, scientific computing, and more. You’ll help teams reach outcomes most engineers can’t on their own.

The FDE team today includes world-class software engineers, computational scientists, ML engineers, and former founders. We’re looking for people with strong engineering fundamentals, deep curiosity across the AI stack, and energy for working directly with customers on hard problems.




WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON:

 - Work hands-on with companies like Suno, Cognition, and Meta to architect and optimize production AI workloads on Modal

 - Collaborate with Modal’s product and sales teams, contributing to the platform as both an engineer and a product stakeholder

 - Build trusted relationships with technical leaders (CTOs, VPs of Engineering, ML leads) at companies doing frontier AI work

 - Conduct technical demos, experiments, and proofs of concept that make Modal’s performance advantages tangible




YOU MAY BE A FIT IF:

 - You have 2+ years of professional ML engineering experience, ideally with hands-on work in inference optimization, model training, GPU programming, or ML infrastructure

 - You’re familiar with the serving (e.g., vLLM, SGLang) and training (e.g., slime, verl, TRL) toolchains and can go deep on at least one (you don’t need all of them)

 - You’re a strong communicator who can go deep on technical architecture with an engineering team and clearly articulate tradeoffs to technical leadership

 - You have a genuine interest in working directly with customers: you find it energizing to understand someone else’s problem and help them solve it

 - You’re willing to work in person in London




NICE-TO-HAVE:

 - Side projects, open-source contributions, or published work you’re proud of in ML or systems performance

CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Infrastructure is our product, and we operate it at a massive scale to power the most demanding workloads.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Junior Software Engineer (IC1/IC2) on the Inference team at CoreWeave, you will take ownership of a single production service end-to-end. This includes shipping features, maintaining dashboards and alarms, and continuously improving operational excellence. You will collaborate closely with peers across runtime, scheduling, and networking teams to advance key Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and ensure high reliability and performance of our inference platform.
  
  
This role offers the opportunity to contribute to an industry-defining inference platform that enables teams to deploy generative AI and real-time applications at scale. If you are passionate about optimizing latency, throughput, and delivering reliable model serving, this position provides an excellent environment for growth and impact.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* 0-3 years of software engineering experience or equivalent, preferably building cloud or distributed services in production environments
* Proficiency in Python or Go programming languages
* Familiarity with gRPC/HTTP APIs and containerized deployments
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes, Slurm, or Ray, and CI/CD pipelines
* Experience with metrics and alerting tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry
* Experience with structured logging practices
* Basic understanding of GPU inference concepts including key-value caching, mixed precision, and streaming tokens
* Nice to have: Experience with inference frameworks such as Triton, vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Ray Serve, or TorchServe
* Nice to have: Hands-on experience with performance profiling and benchmarking tools (e.g., wrk, vegeta, perf, Nsight)
* Nice to have: Contributions to reliability practices such as defining SLIs/SLOs or leading postmortem improvements

**Responsibilities**

* Own one model-serving service end-to-end, including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operational support
* Develop and tune observability tools including dashboards, alerts, and tracing to improve service reliability and reduce manual toil by automating runbook steps
* Optimize latency and throughput through techniques such as micro-batching, concurrency tuning, and caching strategies
* Participate in on-call rotation and lead post-incident action items to ensure continuous service improvement
* Review peer pull requests and contribute constructive design feedback during team code and design reviews
* Collaborate across teams to enhance runtime, scheduling, and networking components impacting inference service performance

**About The Role**
We are seeking a Principal Technical Lead Manager (TLM) to lead the Trajectory Generation team within our Embodied AI organization. This critical role blends deep technical expertise in machine learning and robotics with strong people leadership and organizational impact. Trajectory generation is essential to autonomous driving, responsible for producing precise vehicle motion plans that govern lane changes, merges, turns, yielding, obstacle avoidance, and complex interactions with other road users. As the team leader, you will shape algorithms and ML systems that convert sensor inputs into safe, smooth, and human-like driving behaviors across diverse real-world scenarios. You will manage a high-performing engineering team, drive the technical roadmap from research to production, mentor senior engineers, and lead cross-functional initiatives. This role requires hands-on involvement in technical architecture and modeling strategies while setting the vision and standards for engineering excellence.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* MS or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning, or a related field.
* Proven experience leading technical teams delivering production machine learning systems.
* Deep expertise in one or more of the following areas: robotics planning and control, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, generative models, large-scale machine learning systems.
* Strong software engineering skills, including proficiency in Python, C++, or similar languages.
* Experience deploying ML models into real-world or safety-critical environments.
* Demonstrated ability to define architecture and drive large technical initiatives across multiple teams.
* Preferred qualifications include experience with autonomous driving, robotics, or embodied AI systems.
* Background in trajectory planning, motion planning, or behavior modeling is highly desirable.
* Experience with large-scale training infrastructure and distributed ML pipelines.
* Familiarity with simulation-based training or evaluation of driving policies.

**Responsibilities**

* Define and drive the technical vision and architecture for trajectory generation systems in autonomous driving.
* Lead development of ML-based trajectory generation models capable of handling complex, dynamic driving environments.
* Architect scalable training pipelines utilizing large-scale driving datasets and simulation environments.
* Guide integration of trajectory generation models into real-time onboard systems with strict latency and safety requirements.
* Influence the design of next-generation embodied AI architectures for autonomous driving.
* Mentor senior engineers and cultivate the next generation of technical leaders.
* Raise standards for engineering excellence, modeling rigor, and production-quality systems.
* Foster a culture of innovation, ownership, and collaborative problem-solving.
* Lead complex technical initiatives spanning multiple teams across the autonomous driving stack.
* Collaborate closely with teams working on data, perception, simulation, safety validation, and onboard systems.
* Define roadmaps and priorities aligned with product milestones and safety goals.
* Drive solutions from research prototypes through production deployment.

* Sickness and accident benefits.
* Life insurance coverage.
